resources.string: Your organizer can start the adventure. Everyone in the group is covered.
New steps will stop contributing. Earned steps stay. Joining again starts from a fresh sync.
Rest sets your plan to zero for next week. Incidental steps still contribute unless you pause. Nobody else’s commitment increases.
At your chosen pace: about %1$s weeks remaining
A pace estimate will appear when participating members have set a plan and the combined plan is above zero.
We could not confirm the latest adventure state. Check your connection and refresh before trying again.
A fresh step reading is needed. Connect Health Connect and allow step access, then try again once steps are available.
Another phone is contributing for your account. Pause contribution first, then join again on this phone.
This adventure is not available for this group yet.
The plan changed. Refresh to see the current week and commitment before saving again.
This account no longer has access to the group.
The shared adventure target is fixed once started. Your existing weekly group goal does not change.
Choose between %1$s and %2$s steps for your week.
